name: Extra Checkout Warranty
author: jaychabba

sections.description:
Extra checkout Warranty allows WooCommerce store owners to offer a single, optional warranty during checkout. Customers can choose one warranty option from a dropdown (e.g., 1-year or 2-year coverage), and the plugin dynamically updates the order total and displays the selected warranty in the summary.

This plugin is designed for simplicity, performance, and clarity—ensuring users see the updated price instantly and the selected warranty is preserved throughout the checkout flow.

Features:
* Add a single warranty dropdown to checkout
* Dynamically update total and subtotal via AJAX
* Display selected warranty in order summary
* Show loader while recalculating price
* Compatible with WooCommerce fees and fragments
* Lightweight and extensible architecture
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Warranty Settings to configure options
  4. Warranty dropdown will appear on the checkout page
sections.faq:
Can users select multiple warranties?

No. Extra checkout Warranty is designed to allow only one warranty selection per order. The dropdown enforces single selection to keep pricing and order logic clean.

Does this plugin work with all payment gateways?

Yes, it’s compatible with all standard WooCommerce gateways.

Can I customize the warranty options?

Yes, you can define warranty labels and prices via the plugin settings.

Is the warranty added as a cart fee or line item?

It’s added as a cart fee to ensure compatibility with WooCommerce totals and tax calculations.
